evidence.name: Screen field: Show a close (X) button
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Show a close (X) button" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Show a close (X) button
sections.description: Adds the X in the header that lets people dismiss the paywall and keep browsing. For paid-ad traffic keep it on (optionally with a short reveal delay) — an inescapable paywall hurts trust and can break app-store and ad-network rules. Turn it off only when you deliberately want a hard gate users can't skip.
